summary: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 設計を、skills-only 初回リリースを実装可能な2タスクへ分解する。唯一の実行順序は T001 → T002 である: T001 が package identity、skills-only 境界、および接続・プローブ・MCP 設定を含まないことを固定し、T002 はその確定済みオンボーディングパスに skill と将来 provider 契約を記述し静的テストで固定する。T001 は独立して安全に停止・revert 可能であり、T002 は T001 完了後にだけ開始する。mcp.json、MCP server/provider、アプリ本体、CI、配布、live 接続試験は設計範囲外で変更しない。検証はローカル JSON 構文確認と pytest の静的パッケージ契約テストに限り、外部サービス・資格情報・ネットワークを必要としない。

tasks.title: skills-only プラグイン識別子と構造を固定する
tasks.intent: 設計上の初回リリース境界を manifest と静的テストとして固定し、将来 MCP 拡張を妨げずに package identity を検証可能にする。
acceptance: agent-plugins/idle-talk/plugin.json is valid JSON.
The manifest schema URL exactly matches the designed schema URL.
The manifest name is exactly idle-talk.
The manifest version is exactly 1.0.0.
The manifest includes the designed description.
extensions.com.openai.onboardingSkill is exactly ./skills/idle-talk/SKILL.md.
The manifest test resolves onboardingSkill relative to plugin.json.
The manifest test accepts only the designed package identity.
The manifest test rejects a missing identity field.
The manifest test rejects an altered identity field.
The manifest test rejects an onboarding path outside the package.
The skills-only package has no root agent-plugins/idle-talk/mcp.json.
The manifest test makes no network, process, connection, or capability call.

tasks.title: オンボーディング skill と将来 provider 契約を固定する
tasks.intent: T001 の onboarding path に skill を追加し、設計済みの user-directed workflow、provider 要求・応答契約、タイムアウト、および失敗時の最小権限を文書と静的テストで固定する。
design_refs: Defense mechanisms, tradeoffs, and failure mapping
acceptance: The installed package resolves the manifest onboarding path to skills/idle-talk/SKILL.md.
An unrelated conversation triggers zero connection probes.
An unrelated conversation triggers zero mode-resource loads.
An unrelated conversation triggers zero application requests.
The skill requires a host-configured current connection before status.
The skill requires a host-configured current connection before next.
The skill asks for a mode when user intent is absent.
The skill defaults a mode only for an explicitly stated conversation intent.
The skill never silently selects radio.
The skill never silently selects another local service.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.status request shape.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.status success shape.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.next request shape.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.next success shape.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.cancel request shape.
The skill documents the designed idle_talk.cancel success shape.
Every success preserves the caller requestId when supplied.
Every terminal error preserves the caller requestId when supplied.
A missing requestId is IDLE_TALK_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.
A mismatched requestId is IDLE_TALK_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.
The skill documents exactly the designed terminal codes.
Each terminal error report contains only its code and concise recovery.
The skill permits at most one in-flight request.
The skill permits at most one cancel for an in-flight request.
The skill waits below 30 seconds before cancellation.
The skill issues one cancel at or after 30 seconds.
The skill reports IDLE_TALK_TIMEOUT only when no matching terminal result arrives after the cancel attempt.
A matching completion before cancellation is one terminal success.
The skill performs zero automatic retries.
The skill maintains no hidden queue.
The skill performs no fallback parsing.
The skill performs no fallback calls.
The skill grants no filesystem authority.
The skill grants no shell authority.
The skill grants no arbitrary URL authority.
The skill grants no credential-reading authority.
The skill grants no process-management authority.
Package tests reject a changed canonical timeout.
Package tests reject an undocumented error code.
Package tests reject an omitted requestId.
Package tests reject an altered requestId.
Package tests reject an implicit radio choice.
Package tests reject a second cancel.
Package tests reject an automatic retry.
Package tests reject forbidden authority language.
Package tests reject a root mcp.json in the skills-only release.
